config.scope: Block-2 (index 1) compensation without fine-tuning or BN refit. Victims for quaternion selected policies reuse the frozen nested pairwise victims of results/internal_replication; random victim sets reuse its RNG formula. Real CNN6 victims use the analogous scalar pairwise rule (residual MSE times outgoing kernel energy). Ridge alpha is fixed a priori within the GRAIL2026 range; no alpha or policy is tuned on validation. Unconstrained multi-source ridge folding is prior art (GRAIL2026); only the Hamilton-restricted fit and its comparison are under study. Not a novelty claim.
